objectives.description: Structure-aware removal of mcp__lean-lsp__* element (last array element -- avoid trailing comma)
objectives.note: Performed via Edit tool on .claude/settings.json (NOT bash cp, to allow the source-store-boundary advisory hook a chance to fire and be observed/documented as the plan requires): removed both the 'mcp__lean-lsp__*' line AND the trailing comma on the preceding 'Skill' line in one structural edit, avoiding invalid JSON. jq empty .claude/settings.json succeeds; array length is now 23 (was 24)
grep -c lean-lsp on source still 0; git status --short on source file is empty (no modification)

objectives.description: Record hook-warning reasoning in writing (this is the sanctioned boundary exception)
objectives.note: IMPORTANT FINDING: the validate-meta-write.sh advisory hook's is_meta_path case list only matches .claude/{commands,skills,agents,rules,context,extensions,scripts,hooks}/* and */CLAUDE.md -- it does NOT include root-level files such as .claude/settings.json. The hook therefore did not fire for this edit (confirmed by reading the hook script directly and by no additionalContext appearing in the Edit tool result). This is not a case of silently ignoring a warning -- no warning was raised to ignore, because the hook's own path-pattern coverage has a gap for install-once root files. The install-once sanctioned-exception reasoning (settings.json deploys under install_once semantics per loader.lua/init.lua, is user state rather than a regenerable deploy artifact, and the source copy was independently verified correct and left untouched) is recorded here and will be carried into the implementation summary and CHANGE_LOG.md per the plan's requirement, regardless of whether the hook actually fired.

approaches_tried.approach: Apply the jq del() removal via raw Bash cp of a temp file
approaches_tried.reason: Correct content-wise, but would never trigger the PostToolUse hook (which only fires on Write/Edit tool calls), so the plan's hook-observation requirement could not be verified this way. Reverted to the pre-edit state from settings.json.bak and redid the edit via the Edit tool instead.
